title: prefill/decode: chunked speculative prefill + stage-overlap scheduler optimizations
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce end-to-end latency and improve GPU utilization for mixed prefill/decode workloads (chat and streaming use-cases) by allowing better overlap between prefill and decode stages, introducing chunked prefill, and speculatively running decode on partial KV state. This PR implements a coordinated set of runtime, scheduler and KV-cache changes: 1) chunked prefill path that breaks long prefill sequences into bounded-length chunks to enable earlier decode overlap; 2) speculative prefill that materializes partial KV state and launches speculative decode on likely next chunks (with graceful rollback when speculation misses); 3) stage-overlap scheduler that prioritizes early decode-start candidates and uses a small feedback loop to tune chunk sizes per model/profile; 4) kernel selection hints and micro-batching tweaks to avoid tail latency spikes when chunks finish; 5) KV cache prefetch + eviction conservatively warmed during chunk boundaries. The description below summarizes behavior changes, design trade-offs, and test results. Behavior and safety: speculation is conservative and only enabled for verified-compatible models (profiled offline) and customer workloads with allow_speculative_prefill flag; mis-speculation triggers checkpoint rollback and re-execution without correctness loss. Configuration: new runtime flags (chunk_max_len, speculative_prefill_enabled, speculation_confidence_threshold) and a per-deployment tuning profile. Testing: unit tests for chunk slicing, KV cache consistency tests, integration CUDA kernels smoke, and end-to-end perf against the perf-canary harness. Performance: p95 latency for 1-shot-infer/streaming reduced by ~18% on average across our test profile; sustained throughput increased by ~22% for chat workloads; GPU SM utilization improved by ~10pp. Rollout plan: staged canary on Dedicated, desktop perf-canary runs, feature gated per-customer. Related work: follows up on earlier prefill/decode overlap PRs (see pr-38421, pr-37892) and integrates kernel selection heuristics added in pr-36247. Linked Linear tasks: ENG-4521, ENG-4470.

review_comments: Carlos Mendez (2024-09-19): Overall looks good. A few nits: 1) can we make the default chunk_max_len smaller for CPU-bound models? 2) the scheduler feedback loop needs a safety cap to avoid oscillation.
Aisha Patel (2024-09-19): Responded: Default chunk_max_len set to 64 for CPU profiles; feedback loop has new min/max clamps and hysteresis. Added unit tests for the clamp behavior.
Sophie Grant (2024-09-20): Question: how does speculative prefill interact with KV encryption/HSM-backed keys? Need to ensure we never leak materialized partial state outside customer boundary.

Aisha Patel (2024-09-20): Reply: speculative materialization respects existing KMS/HSM boundaries; we added a code path that avoids in-memory plaintext copies when encryption is enabled and added an integration test (kv_consistency_test.py) for encrypted cache flows.
Igor Petrov (2024-09-22): Approval after CI green and perf-canary results look good. Canary numbers: p95 down 17-20% across 3 model profiles; throughput up 20-24%.
SRE Bot (2024-09-23): CI: integration-only test failed once (timeout on perf-canary runner). Re-run passed.
merge_summary: Squash merged after CI passed and perf-canary approvals. Feature gated; rollout to Dedicated and canary customers planned over next two weeks.
notes_for_ops: Operator flags: runtime.flags.chunk_max_len (int), runtime.flags.speculative_prefill_enabled (bool), runtime.flags.speculation_confidence_threshold (float). Default: speculative_prefill_enabled=false for hosted; allowed in Dedicated/Private on opt-in. If mis-speculation rate > 2% for a workload, reduce chunk_max_len or disable speculative_prefill.
test_plan: Unit tests for chunked prefill and KV checkpointing; integration tests in perf-canary harness; regression tests for existing decode-only and prefill-only paths; encrypted KV flow test. Canary rollout with telemetry: mis-speculation_rate, rollback_count, chunk_completion_latency histogram.
changelog_summary: Add chunked prefill, speculative partial-kv materialization, and stage-overlap scheduler to improve latency and throughput for mixed prefill/decode workloads. Operator flags and canary rollout included.
notes: This PR reconciles several prior efforts (see pr-38421 and pr-36247) and is intentionally conservative: speculation disabled by default and only enabled when model profile signals compatibility. Further iterations will explore adaptive chunk sizing and model-specific kernel tuning.
